title: From a coupled formulation library to a tested design map
subtitle: Measure material state, select kinetic and connectivity contrasts, then test held-out predictions.
footer: Prospective schematic — contrasts are selected from measured state, not assumed from recipe.
caption: A 27-formulation library exposes coupled recipe effects. Measured relaxation, elastic state, and connectivity identify kinetic and topology contrasts before property outcomes are examined; a design map advances only after held-out prediction.
altText: Four-stage proposal schematic. A factorial polymer library is mapped into measured material coordinates, selected contrasts are tested, and only agreement with held-out formulations yields a transferable design map.
